source.origin: Kieso et al. Intermediate Accounting 19e, ch.2 The Accounting Information System, Put It into Practice LO 2.3 'Prepare Adjusting Entries and Show Their Effects on the Trial Balance' (book p. 2-35..2-36), Kleene Window Washing Inc.
source.ground_truth_provenance: textbook printed solution (Put It into Practice LO 2.3)

prompt: 7/31 の決算整理仕訳 5 件を起票し, 整理後試算表を作成せよ。

map_note.Supplies: No dedicated Supplies (asset) constructor exists in EA's elementary chart; aliased to the generic deferral-asset account PrepaidExpenses. This collides with PrepaidInsurance (also aliased to PrepaidExpenses) — the EA oracle will merge two economically distinct GT sub-ledgers onto one account. Accounting-review point.
map_note.PrepaidInsurance: No PrepaidInsurance-specific constructor exists; aliased to the generic deferral-asset account PrepaidExpenses (same collision as Supplies above).
map_note.Equipment: No literal Equipment constructor; EA's elementary PP&E set is Building/Machinery/Vehicle/Fixtures. Aliased to Fixtures (備品, general small-business capital equipment) as the closest generic fit absent more specific detail.
map_note.CommonStock: Aliased to CapitalStock (資本金) — treated as a clear naming translation (US-GAAP CommonStock ≈ contributed capital), not a coverage gap.
map_note.Dividends: EA's elementary chart has no temporary Dividends-declared contra-equity account (no US-style declaration-date entry modeled at the 日商簿記 elementary level). Aliased directly to RetainedEarnings, which is where a declared dividend nets out at closing anyway; this loses the temporary-account audit trail. Accounting-review point.
map_note.MaintenanceAndRepairsExpense: No maintenance/repairs-specific expense constructor; aliased to the generic catch-all MiscellaneousExpenses. Accounting-review point.
map_note.SalariesAndWagesExpense: Aliased to WageExpenditure (給料) — treated as a clear naming translation (salaries+wages combined into one wage-expense account), not a coverage gap.
map_note.DepreciationExpense: Aliased to Depreciation (減価償却費) — clear naming translation; same alias already used in closing-depreciation-straightline-003.
map_note.AccumulatedDepreciationEquipment: EA's AccumulatedDepreciation constructor is generic (no per-asset-class subdivision); the '...Equipment' qualifier is dropped. Aliased to AccumulatedDepreciation. Accounting-review point — EA cannot currently distinguish accumulated depreciation by underlying asset class.
map_note.SuppliesExpense: Aliased to SuppliesExpenses (pluralization-only difference) — clear naming translation, not a coverage gap.
map_note.SalariesAndWagesPayable: Aliased to AccruedExpenses (未払費用, deferral-accrual liability) — a strong conceptual fit for a period-end accrued-salaries adjusting entry, though the constructor is generic rather than salary-specific.

adjustment_data: 未請求・未収の役務提供 1,700(7/31)
保険料の 1/12 が当月分(PrepaidInsurance 1,800)

expected_output.format_note: Return a single JSON object with keys "journal" (the 5 adjusting entries as 10 postings: accrued unbilled revenue, equipment depreciation, insurance expiration, supplies used, accrued salaries) and "derived" (flat map with keys "adjusted_trial_balance_totals.debit" and "adjusted_trial_balance_totals.credit").

review: 整理後試算表合計 25,880 = 25,880 の一致と, 各整理仕訳の deferral/accrual 分類・正準科目名の妥当性。
